title: Anthropic likely to price IPO above the current range of $70 to $78, sources tell CNBC
html:
Anthropic is likely to price its IPO above the current range of $70 to $78, multiple sources told CNBC's David Faber on Tuesday.

The artificial intelligence company is planning to list on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol "ANT" and start trading on Nov. 19.
